observations.body: Freedom becomes service through love. For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another. But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

payload.tension: The passage states freedom becomes service through love. For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another. But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
